The Reserve Bank of India is anticipated to keep interest rates steady for a considerable duration, with heightened global yields providing minimal support to local interest rates.

EBITDA rose 18% to Rs 48 crore, though margins moderated. The defence company said its best-ever first-quarter performance reflects strong execution and continued sector demand.

Notably, AGS Health, known for its revenue cycle management services for U.S. hospitals, achieved a profit of 2.07 billion rupees last fiscal year.

title: Sumadhura Group to invest Rs 2,000 cr on construction of housing project in Bengaluru

With a strong pipeline exceeding 40 million square feet, this project underscores the robust growth opportunities in East Bengaluru.

title: US Treasury yields fall as jobs report dashes hike bets

Traders subsequently lowered their predictions for an interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve in the upcoming September meeting. While the unemployment rate dipped, labor participation faced a decline, coupled with slower wage increases. This shift in the jobs market could indicate a shift towards a more dovish stance from the Federal Reserve.
